description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations -  Industrial Disputes between Mr. S. A. Daya Keerthi Bandara & Merchant Bank of Sri Lanka and Finance PLC - Lanka Estate and Industrial Workers' Union  & Dcle Lanka (Pvt.) Ltd. and Weerasinhe Manpower Supliers (Pvt.) Ltd - L. P. Jayasundara and LRDC Services (Pvt.) Ltd.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of statutory powers under the Industrial Disputes Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It contains legal orders made under specific legislative authority (Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act), references to legislative enactments and amendments, and formal legal procedures for dispute resolution. While it mentions a government minister (Ravindra Samaraweera), this is incidental to the legal/regulatory function being performed rather than constituting a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment. The core content is regulatory in nature, dealing with the legal framework for industrial dispute resolution.
